obligation: E-Verify Memorandum of Understanding for Employers
basis: Enrolled 2024-03-04 because two Light Industrial clients require E-Verify in their contracts. The MOU covers user access (II.A.3), the tutorial (II.A.5), case timing (II.A.9), verification of all new hires (II.A.11), safeguarding of E-Verify information and passwords (II.A.15), and immediate breach notice to DHS (II.A.16)

Every employer must verify new employees within 3 business days, document any E-Verify outage, and keep the documentation at least 3 years. The E-Verify mandate in (2)(b)2. reaches private employers with 25 or more employees, and (1)(b) defines an employee as an individual filling a permanent position. The firm has 7 permanent staff; whether its associates count is not settled. Practice does not change, because the MOU already requires E-Verify for all new hires
